{{Quote|That's kind of funny&mdash;you'd think two planets could find a decent artist between 'em so there wouldn't be this wild gundark chase.|Testimony of Barzur Antilles, in reference to Alsakan and Maya Kovel|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
'''Maya Kovel''' was a windswept [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which had already developed [[Realspace/Legends|spaceflight]] technology prior to its first contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]]. The Ayrou went on to have a significant presence throughout the larger [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector's]] [[Inner Zuma Region|Inner]] and [[Outer Zuma]] regions, including control over the [[Vashan]]-[[Miner/Legends|worked]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the planet [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]].

Following the first contact with the Republic, the Ayrou on Maya Kovel underwent a religious upheaval that saw them discard the treasure accumulated under the tenets of their previous [[Il Madri|religious tradition]]. Some of those riches were loaded aboard [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and shot into [[Maya Kovel's sun]], while the exact location of one other such treasure vault was hidden on a [[Chalcedony/Legends|chalcedony]] idol known as the [[Ayrou Tessent]]&mdash;at some point spirited offworld, it was eventually discovered on Vasha by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the reign of both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], Ayrou [[Senator/Legends|senators]] represented Maya Kovel and the rest of the Moddell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|legislative]] [[Galactic Alliance Senate|bodies]] of those governments.

==Description==
Maya Kovel was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Endor" /> located in the [[Maya Kovel system/Legends|Maya Kovel system]]. It lay within the [[Inner Moddell systems]] area of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC MayaKovel" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC MayaKovel" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Annaj-Houche Run]] connected it to the [[Thonner system/Legends|Thonner]] and [[Vasha system/Legends|Vasha systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star/Legends|stars]] and [[Kuna systems|star systems]] of [[Kuna's Eye/Legends|Kuna's Eye]], [[Kuna's Fist/Legends|Kuna's Fist]], [[Kuna's Gullet]], [[Kuna's Heart]], [[Kuna's Horn/Legends|Kuna's Horn]], [[Kuna's Scale]], [[Kuna's Tail system/Legends|Kuna's Tail]], and [[Kuna's Tooth system/Legends|Kuna's Tooth]], so named by Maya Kovel's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]], all together formed the [[Kuna constellation]] in the planet's [[Local day/Legends|night]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]].<ref name="Endor" />

Maya Kovel [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Maya Kovel's sun|single star]]<ref name="Tessent" /> and was itself circled by an airless [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The planet's [[local year]] lasted 463 local [[Standard day/Legends|days]], each of which was twenty-nine [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long. Its [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was ninety percent standard. Although Maya Kovel had a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate, it also had a<ref name="Endor" /> thin,<ref name="CSWE MayaKovel">{{CSWECite|II|296|Maya Kovel}}</ref> acrid Type II atmosphere.<ref name="Endor" /> It gave rise to regular<ref name="CSWE MayaKovel" /> fierce windstorms<ref name="Endor" /> that exposed<ref name="CSWE MayaKovel" /> vast deposits of [[Iron/Legends|iron]] oxide,<ref name="Endor" /> iron, and other elements in the planet's soil and rock,<ref name="CSWE MayaKovel" /> leading to Maya Kovel's surface having a deep-[[Color/Legends|red]] appearance<ref name="Endor" /> when viewed from [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="CSWE MayaKovel" /> In addition, the planet's air often caused in [[Human/Legends|Human]] visitors to Maya Kovel who did not wear [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] a hacking cough that, if left untreated, could lead to a dangerous shortness of breath.<ref name="Endor" />

[[Desert/Legends|Desert]] dominated the surface of Maya Kovel, although the planet's rift valleys were carpeted in colonies of a type of dark green [[Maya Kovel lichen|lichen]] that developed from [[Seed/Legends|seeds]]. The lichen developed whenever those seeds found themselves out of the wind and with a reliable source of [[Water/Legends|water]], despite such circumstances sometimes taking [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] to arise.<ref name="Endor" /> At one point, Maya Kovel was home to a [[Ayrou precursor species|birdlike species]] from which the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Ayrou evolved.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
===First contact===
[[File:Tessent2-Gamer9.png|thumb|right|300px|The Ayrou Tessent was at one point spirited away from Maya Kovel.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began visiting what would eventually become the Moddell sector, Maya Kovel's native Ayrou species were one of the few of the sector's species that had already developed spaceflight, establishing a research station on their homeworld's moon<ref name="Endor" /> and exploring as far as the<ref name="Tessent" /> [[Outer Moddell systems]]<ref name="Endor" /> planet [[Ast Kikorie/Legends|Ast Kikorie]] via the use of unmanned drones. When Ayrou scouts made first contact with the Republic&mdash;an event that cause more upheaval than any other in the species' modern history&mdash;the Ayrou were following a religious tradition known as ''[[il Madri]]'', which decreed the hoarding of material treasures.<ref name="Tessent" />

After first contact, however, the species rapidly and utterly renounced ''il Madri'', with the hierarchs of the tradition's chapterhouses declaring their accumulated wealth taboo. Accordingly, the contents of some chapterhouses' treasure vaults were subsequently loaded aboard [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and shot into Maya Kovel's sun. According to a legend, the riches of the [[Ur-Chapterhouse]] of ''il Madri'' were hidden in one of the [[Kuna systems]], with their encoded coordinates placed in [[Ayrou Tessent|one]] of the [[Alsakan Tessent|two]] [[Chalcedony/Legends|chalcedony]] idols known as the [[Tessent]]s. The Ayrou Tessent was said to have eventually been spirited off Maya Kovel.<ref name="Tessent" />

===Into the wider galaxy===
[[File:Vashan2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Ayrou of Maya Kovel eventually gained control over the Vashan-worked mines of Vasha (two Vashans on Vasha pictured).]]
The Republic scouts saw the Ayrou as a natural candidate for joining their government, and the Moddell sector became a nominal part of the Republic around [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]]. The Ayrou subsequently gained a widespread presence in the sector as well as powerful influence throughout the Inner and [[Outer Zuma]] regions. Affluent entrepreneurs on Maya Kovel became one of the parties financing [[Trindellan oak]] [[logging]] operations on the moon [[Trindello/Legends|Trindello]],<ref name="Endor" /> and the Ayrou made a virtual vassal out of the [[Vashan]]s [[Miner/Legends|working]] in the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on their homeworld, [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]]&mdash;although not all Vashans were content with the Ayrou control, leading to the [[Vashan Liberation Force]], a small group of approximately twenty Vashans posing no real threat to Maya Kovel's forces, being formed on the planet [[Sarafur]].<ref name="Tessent" />

The Ayrou also maintained a [[Prison/Legends|penal]] colony on the planet [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following its [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]]<ref name="Tessent" /> in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="Endor" /> For at least sixteen years the Ayrou used Thonner to [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerate]] individuals who had resorted to physical violence to achieve their goals, including a [[Unidentified Thonnerman|non-Ayrou]] who had been imprisoned after becoming involved in a fistfight on Maya Kovel. Eventually, however, the Ayrou largely withdrew their presence from Thonner and denied having ever used the world as a prison.<ref name="Tessent" />

{{RPG|"[[Race for the Tessent]]"}}
At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY">By default, the events of {{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}} are set during the opposition to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]], which depict the [[Battle of the City of Bone|end]] of the Imperial presence on Mandalore per {{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}, to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> before the Alsakan and Ayrou Tessents were discovered on Ast Kikorie and Vasha, respectively, [[Barzur Antilles]] gave a testimony at the [[Annaj House of Detention|House of Detention]] of<ref name="Tessent" /> the planet [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Moddell sector.<ref name="Endor" /> Antilles expressed their lack of appreciation for the artwork displayed between the two idols, implying that it indicated a lack of a "decent [[Artist/Legends|artist]]" both on Maya Kovel and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] that in turn supposedly contributed to the complicated nature of the ongoing [[Treasure hunting/Legends|search]] for the Tessents.<ref name="Tessent" /> An Ayrou [[Senator/Legends|senator]] represented Maya Kovel and the Moddell in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]<ref name="Endor" /> by [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="19 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', which include an appearance of an [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> a practice which continued with that governmental body's successor, the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TEA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Ayrou/Legends}}
{{Quote|Sixteen years those rail-thin, self-righteous Ayrou kept me locked up in that stinking, rotten-fish-infested hole. One fistfight on their world, and they think you're a menace to heir culture.|A former prisoner of Ayrou, on their incarceration on Thonner|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
[[File:Ayrou_SWG9.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Maya Kovel was the homeworld of the Ayrou.]]
Maya Kovel was the homeworld of the sentient, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] Ayrou species, who spoke the [[Ayrou (language)|Ayrou]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. Wily negotiators and tireless [[Collector/Legends|collectors]] of information, the Ayrou also were pacifists who shunned physical violence as a sign of an individual's weakness of character.<ref name="Endor" /> The Vashans, a virtual vassal species of the Ayrou, eventually adopted for their society the latter's tradition of periodic religious upheaval.<ref name="Tessent" />

The inhabitants of Maya Kovel, which was home to three hundred million Ayrou, two-hundred-and-fifty thousand Vashans, and twenty-five thousand Humans, had access to space-[[Technology level|level]] technology, including six [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]: two [[Stellar-class starport|stellar-class]] and four of limited services. They imported technology from off-world and in return exported [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]]. In addition, the clan-based Ayrou, who [[Farm/Legends|farmed]] the [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] growing in Maya Kovel's rift valleys, exported their delicious undeveloped seeds throughout the Inner Zuma sectors.<ref name="Endor" /> At some point, the Human scout [[Cobb Salfur]] hired out [[Gender/Legends|his]] services at Maya Kovel's spaceports.<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Maya Kovel was introduced in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> Within the magazine, the planet was mentioned in the source article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]" as well as the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Race for the Tessent]]," both being written for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Endor" /><ref name="Tessent" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />

Instead of featuring a set plot, "Race for the Tessent" presents several settings in the Moddell sector that the player characters may visit during their search for the artifacts known as the Tessents. For each of the settings, the adventure also suggests possible circumstances for a Tessent being hidden there. Assuming that as much of the non-contradictory information presented in the adventure as possible is [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, this article assumes that the Alsakan Tessent and the Ayrou Tessent were hidden on the planets Ast Kikorie and Vasha, respectively.<ref name="Tessent" />
